score.precision_formula: e_l=RMS(concat_all_samples(Ydesign_l-Yfloat_l))/max(RMS(concat_all_samples(Yfloat_l)),1e-8); e=max_l e_l; require e<=0.03 and all finite; S_precision=max(0,10-e/0.003), e is a fraction
score.performance_precision: all12 formally selected FFN1 tasks each individually satisfy NRMSE<=0.03, not only12-layer aggregate

efficiency_formulas.rounding: two decimal places; extrema from qualified same-group entrants

score.qualification_gate: All mandatory tasks + all required functional cases + numerical threshold + RTL bit equality + 150MHz + added area<=2.25mm2 must pass before efficiency AND innovation scoring.
score.no_comparable_participant_extrema: Actual score or global optimum cannot be computed locally; do not invent T_max/E_min/A_min. Use constrained Pareto comparisons and measured local proxies.
score.optional_attention_not_required: Undergraduate innovation can use pipelining/double buffering/reuse/low power/numeric representation/full FFN or later tasks. Attention/full encoder is not required for undergraduate qualification or full innovation score.
